summary: SITE Centers Corp. subsidiary sold its ground leasehold and other interests in The Pike Outlets (Long Beach, CA) to Pike Long Beach Owner LLC for $50.0 million cash per a May 1, 2026 Purchase Agreement. Net closing proceeds were ~$46.5 million. No board recommendation, advisor, premium percentage, or closing timeline is disclosed. The sale is an asset-level disposition, not a corporate separation. Watch for the use of proceeds and any impact on SITE Centers' portfolio strategy; no risk-arb angle given the straightforward cash sale.
